note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Both scenarios keep every fact identical except the selected date; the layer marked for each date is supplied by the author, never computed, and no outcome or legal effect is stated.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative

presets.description: Substantive alternative: a four-version history; A's date is marked inside the oldest layer (three later ghosts, the card travels to the top of the rail) and B's date inside the third layer (one later ghost).
